FAQ

What is the best deck in Palworld TCG right now?

By win rate against the current field, Lamball · Cattiva at 58.1% over 8,077 games. The most played is Chillet · Relaxaurus at 31.2% of all decks.

Should I go first or second in Palworld TCG?

Second, for most decks: the player going second wins 53.1% and the player going first 46.9%. The toss is automatic and uses your deck’s turn preference, which defaults to second.

What beats Chillet · Relaxaurus?

Cattiva · Azurobe (54%), Lamball · Cattiva (53%), Lamball · Stone Pit (48%)

How is the tier list made?

From every online game between two players on this site; bots and practice games are never counted. Tiers use win rate against the field. Updated daily.
